methodologyNotes: The 9 most-compared Workforce Management tools, ranked by entry price. Each vendor's cheapest published self-serve plan, free tier, and compliance posture is sourced verbatim from the vendor's own pricing page (or a dated corroboration) — quote-only tiers are marked, never guessed.

vendors.name: Deputy

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: $5.50 per user per month (USD, excl. taxes), billed monthly; $5 per user per month on the annual side, billed upfront or in monthly installments; includes basic scheduling, timesheets, and time clocking. USD $30/month minimum spend per invoice applies on monthly plans.

vendors.provenance: Re-fetched the Deputy pricing page (https://www.deputy.com/pricing) on 2026-07-10. It shows three self-serve plans in USD: Lite at $5, Core at $6.50, and Pro at $9, each stated verbatim as "per user per month (USD excl. all applicable taxes)" and "billed upfront or in monthly installments". Lite is the lowest paid tier ("Everything you need to get started with scheduling and time tracking"). A FAQ on the same page confirms a minimum monthly spend of USD $30 per invoice on monthly Lite/Core/Pro plans. Only a free trial ("Start free trial"), no $0-forever plan, so there is no free tier. No HIPAA or SOC2 statement appears on the page, so neither is recorded. "Deputy Payroll enabled by Paycor" confirms the Paycor integration. Correct vendor (Deputy Corporation, workforce management: scheduling + time tracking). All fields verified against the live page. Re-verified 2026-09-03 against the live pricing page; published figures unchanged.

plans.name: Basic

Includes real-time GPS clock in/out, unlimited jobs, payroll integration, basic scheduling incl. open shifts, unlimited checklists/forms/tasks. Communications and HR & Skills Hubs each have their own Basic at $35/mo monthly with lower per-user overage.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $44.99/month (monthly-billed; $39.99/month billed annually). Unlimited locations, 30 employees per location; advanced scheduling, team communication, labor cost controls & budgeting, basic time clocking, permissions.

vendors.provenance: Re-fetched both pages. The 7shifts pricing page (https://www.7shifts.com/pricing/) is JS-rendered and self-describes as a "Restaurant Scheduling and Payroll Platform" with a restaurant-type "Built For" list (confirms correct vendor, not a sibling), but exposes NO USD price figures in its text. Because prices are hidden behind JS, verification relied on the corroboration: Connecteam's "Honest 7shifts Review" (https://connecteam.com/reviews/7shifts/), updated July 2, 2026, which carries a verbatim June 2026 pricing table: Comp (Free), Essentials $44.99/month ($39.99/month billed annually), Pro $89.99/month, Premium $149.99/month. This confirms VERBATIM the lowest self-serve paid plan (Essentials) at $44.99/month monthly-billed, plus a genuinely free Comp plan (1 location, 15 employees/location). Essentials feature/limit claims all match the table (unlimited locations, 30 employees/location, advanced scheduling, team communication, labor cost controls & budgeting, basic time clocking, permissions). The same review names payroll integrations ADP, Gusto, Paychex, and QuickBooks Online. HIPAA is not recorded: no HIPAA statement on either page (security section lists MFA, RBAC, TLS, AES-256, PCI-DSS, IEC 27001, ISO, SOC only). Both a verbatim sourced price and a genuine free tier survive, so this entry is published. Re-verified 2026-09-03 against the live pricing page; published figures unchanged.

It sits at the communications end of a table whose incumbents span from scheduling-first to time-tracking-only, which is a difference of emphasis rather than of category.
